title: Gmail OAuth2 Manager: headhunter scan + draft via Gmail API
desc: gmail_manager.py: OAuth2-based Gmail inbox monitor for headhunter detection, auto-draft, and send. Reads creds from D:\GitHub\.env central secrets. No IMAP app password needed -- uses refresh_token flow.
steps: Setup: python resume/scripts/gmail_manager.py setup -- auto-reads GMAIL_CLIENT_ID, GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET, GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN, GMAIL_EMAIL from D:\GitHub\.env
OAuth2 token refresh: POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token with grant_type=refresh_token. Returns short-lived access_token. No user interaction needed.
Gmail API: Bearer token header. List unread: GET /gmail/v1/users/me/messages?q=is:unread in:inbox maxResults=20. Fetch body: ?format=full. Body is base64url-encoded in payload parts.
Headhunter detection: keyword match on subject+sender (recruiter, headhunter, position offer, etc). Generates Korean reply draft. Creates Gmail draft via POST /gmail/v1/users/me/drafts.
Send saved draft: POST /gmail/v1/users/me/drafts/{id}/send. Fallback: POST /gmail/v1/users/me/messages/send with raw RFC822 base64url body.
Notify via .wkappbot/pending_prompts/prompt_NOW_{guid}.json for Eye delivery to Claude session.
Commands: check (scan+draft+notify), preview (list unread subjects), list (show pending drafts), send <msg_id>
author: claude
